Container.Name: aoostar-display-studio
Container.Overview: Local-first 960x376 USB LCD Studio and Unraid telemetry engine for Aoostar NAS hardware (WTR MAX / GEM12+ PRO) by JoshC1994. Replaces proprietary OEM software with direct USB-UART streaming, drag-and-drop screen design, ApexCharts, custom HTML/images/video, and Home Assistant integration.
Container.Description: Aoostar Display Studio gives you full local control over the 960x376 secondary USB-UART display (VID 0x0416, PID 0x90A1) on Aoostar NAS hardware without any proprietary cloud software.[br][br][b]Features:[/b][br]- Drag-and-drop 960x376 screen designer with Blank, Saved, and Template screen workflows[br]- Live Unraid server telemetry (CPU, RAM, array disks, thermals, Docker containers, tasks, SMB users)[br]- Exposed Entities registry for custom tag/unit naming and 1-click placement[br]- Home Assistant and custom local HTTP/JSON endpoint integration[br]- Autonomous background daemon that continues updating and rotating screens automatically across restarts[br]- Brightness, orientation, and overnight sleep schedule controls
Container.Requires: Aoostar secondary USB-UART display (/dev/ttyACM0, VID 0x0416 PID 0x90A1). Works standalone in preview mode even if no display is attached.
